t: G38 Documentary Engine: Corroboration Math — Simple
name: G38 Documentary Engine: Corroboration Math — Simple
title: G38 Documentary Engine: Corroboration Math — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Independent sources multiply confidence: if each source is 80% reliable and they agree independently, the joint confidence is computed by Bayes, not by gut. The desk runs the update so 'confirmed by two sources' becomes a number.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Posterior: two 80%-reliable sources agree (prior 0.5) = 0.9412 probability. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

real_world_basis: Bayesian corroboration is the real math of evidence combination.

safety: No hazard; the failure mode is two sources that share one origin — independence must be checked.
how_it_works: Set each source's reliability, apply Bayes on agreement, and report the posterior. The demo corroborates a disputed date.
